items.title: IBM and Lockheed Bet Big on Europe’s Thriving Quantum Scene
items.summary: International Business Machines  and  Lockheed Martin  are strengthening their existing relationship by creating a quantum innovation hub in Switzerland, the partners announced early Thursday.  At the heart of the agreement is the deployment of an IBM Quantum System Two, the latest generation of the company’s flagship quantum computer, which will be accessible to academics, researchers, and enterprises in the country.  The IBM system will be deployed at the Swiss National Supercomputing Center, which is affiliated with ETH Zurich, a prominent public research university.
